title: Cleopatra Mode is Hilarious
body: I tried the Cleopatra transformation, and I couldn’t stop laughing. It’s surprisingly detailed and makes you look so regal. My friends and I spent hours just playing around with it. Great for parties or just killing time!

title: Made cute stickers
body: Turned my AI avatars into stickers. They look so good on my laptop and phone—super fun and personal

title: Took a selfie with a dragon 🐉
body: Bro... I found this feature where you can literally pose with a dragon. Like, full-on fire-breathing beast right next to me. I tried it for fun and ended up looking like I just walked out of a fantasy movie poster. Didn’t think I needed a selfie with a dragon until now, but here we are. Honestly feels like having a CGI team in my pocket. 10/10, would slay again.

title: Shocked how good this is
body: Tried this on a whim — typed in a random story idea about a wizard and a runaway toaster, and boom, it turned into a full animated video. Way smoother than I expected. I’ve messed with a few text-to-video tools before, but this one’s actually fun and fast. Great for sharing silly stuff with friends.

title: Cartoon avatar perfection
body: The cartoon avatars look amazing! I turned one of my selfies into a big-eyed animated version of me, and now it’s my profile pic everywhere. Even my mom asked me which “Pixar movie” I was in 😄. It’s fun, flattering, and a little addictive—every time I try a new filter, I end up saving like 10 versions.

title: Sick
body: Tried one of the effects that turns you into a race car driver-not gonna lie, it looked insanely cool. I sent it to my group chat and they all thought I edited it in premiere or something 😂. Didn’t expect an app to pull this off so easily

title: Game changer
body: Ai Catch has a wide variety of features perfect for anime fans

title: Fun app. Love the AI hug
body: My sister and I just can’t stop making AI hugs with our celebrity crush. At first it’s just a random try when I saw their features on social media, soon it’s like non-stop. I think it’s great when AI features can actually make you have more chances to see how creativity can meet with AI videos. And pls make more templates for us to try I’m begging
